messages.author: 6a7c73c947c1c7b0
messages.subject: Multi Step Analysis in Shiny
parts:
Hi all,


Is it possible/convenient to have a multi-step analysis pipeline in Shiny? I envision something like the user uploading a data file, then being presented with a couple of preprocessing plots, making a decision, clicking on “Next”, then the next step of the analysis happens etc…

I am not sure right now if Shiny is more made for simple input/output types of analyses?


Thanks,
Rohan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Multi Step Analysis in Shiny
parts: Generally people do this with multiple tabs. You can also do this with a renderUI if you don't want to let people jump backward and forward between different steps; create a separate Shiny module for each step, and create a reactiveVal() to track which step the user is currently on, and use a uiOutput/renderUI in your main UI which will display the UI of whichever module corresponds to the current step.
